headline: Chandigarh AAP leader Pardeep Chhabra passes away at 65
content: <p>Chandigarh: AAP leader and former Chandigarh mayor Pardeep Chhabra passed away here on Tuesday. He was 65.</p>.<p>He is survived by his wife, son and two daughters.</p>.<p>The AAP leader's son, Puneet Chhabra, said his father had been undergoing treatment for jaundice and complained of ill health in the morning.</p>.ED could file case on how AAP leaders are breathing, says Atishi.<p>"We called an ambulance to take him to PGIMER here, but he passed away," Puneet said.</p>.<p>Chhabra was the co-in-charge of the Aam Aadmi Party in Chandigarh. He was also the chairman of the Punjab Large Industrial Development Board.</p>.<p>He had joined the AAP in August 2021 after quitting the Congress. </p>
